changes.subject: mobile-onboarding

after.title: Save the application and resume it later
after.description:
As a customer who stops halfway, I want to save my application and resume it on another device, so that I do not start again.

Definition of ready:
- [ ] The team understands the need and its value.
after.acceptance criteria:
- [ ] The application is kept for 30 days.
- [ ] The customer gets a link by mail to resume it.

changes.reason: The workshop asks that a customer can resume an application.

changes.subject: mobile-onboarding

after.title: Branch finder
after.description:
As a customer who prefers a branch, I want to find the nearest one, so that I finish my application there.

Definition of ready:
- [ ] The team understands the need and its value.
after.acceptance criteria: - [ ] Given a postcode, the app lists the three nearest branches with their opening hours.

changes.reason: The workshop asks that a customer finds the nearest branch.
